title: Release workflow with npm trusted publishing
goal: A v* tag publishes from GitHub Actions without a token
acceptance: .github/workflows/release.yml: on a pushed tag vX.Y.Z only (never a PR); verify (tag on main, matches projects/bricks/package.json version, CHANGELOG entry), the full CI check job (reusable ci.yml), build and npm pack without publish rights, then `npm publish --provenance --access public` of that tarball
id-token: write only in the publish job (environment npm), which checks out no code and installs no dependencies; no NPM_TOKEN; npm 11.5.1 or later asserted
The tag must match projects/bricks/package.json version
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no consuming project's real data, secrets or tokens in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Done 2026-11-25 in one PR with a fresh-context design review; verification is the first publish (F-004-T06). No actual: the step's start time was not recorded.
